meta.title: RALIN — PT Rasa Kuliner Indocipta
meta.description: PT Rasa Kuliner Indocipta (RALIN) — building brands, creating experiences and growing together. Home of Tedja Coffee and Sajikawani.

hero.title: Building brands. Creating experiences. Growing together.
hero.body: We believe the culinary business is not only about what is served on the table, but also about the space, the experience and the connections created around it.

intro.title: It started with one idea, then grew into more possibilities.
intro.body: PT Rasa Kuliner Indocipta builds food & beverage brands that are relevant, create meaningful experiences and grow together with everyone who is part of the journey.

careers.title: Grow with RALIN.
careers.body: We're always looking for people who care about hospitality — baristas, cooks, hosts and the teams behind them.

story.title: It started with one idea, then grew into more possibilities.
story.p1: PT Rasa Kuliner Indocipta was founded on the belief that the culinary business is not only about what is served on the table, but also about the space, the experience and the connections created around it.
story.p2: One of our first steps is Tedja Coffee — and this is only the beginning. Next is Sajikawani, a fried chicken restaurant currently in preparation.
story.p3: We will keep evolving: building relevant brands, creating meaningful experiences and growing together with everyone who is part of this journey.
